findings.message: Debrief for team-beta is missing rubric feedback: R3, R4.
findings.detail: All solver teams should receive feedback tied to the same accepted rubric.
findings.remediation: Add solver-facing comments for every accepted rubric item.

findings.message: Feedback for rubric R1 is too thin or lacks a next action.
findings.detail: Detected 2 words and no actionable verb.
findings.remediation: Give the solver concrete, rubric-linked changes or evidence to preserve.

findings.message: Debrief appeal deadline differs from the challenge policy for team-beta.
findings.remediation: Synchronize the debrief appeal deadline with the accepted challenge policy.

findings.message: Feedback coverage varies from 2 to 4 rubric comments across teams.
findings.detail: Uneven debrief depth can create appearance of favoritism or weaken appeal records.
findings.remediation: Normalize feedback coverage so every team receives comparable rubric-linked detail.

findings.message: Debrief exposes private benchmark or holdout label: Sponsor-Holdout-Beta.
findings.detail: Private benchmark names can leak sponsor evaluation data and bias future attempts.
findings.remediation: Replace private benchmark names with public rubric language before release.

findings.message: Debrief exposes private benchmark or holdout label: InternalRetrosynthesisSet-14.
findings.detail: Private benchmark names can leak sponsor evaluation data and bias future attempts.
findings.remediation: Replace private benchmark names with public rubric language before release.

findings.message: Debrief exposes reviewer identity material: Dr. Mira Lin.
findings.detail: Reviewer identity disclosure can compromise anonymous review and invite retaliation.
findings.remediation: Remove reviewer names, emails, aliases, and identity hints from solver-facing text.

findings.message: Debrief references another team's protected submission material: AlphaFold wet-lab bridge.
findings.detail: Solver feedback must not disclose another team's private methods, artifacts, or trade secrets.
findings.remediation: Rewrite the feedback using only the recipient team's public rubric outcome.

findings.message: Debrief includes direct payment or off-platform payout language.
findings.detail: Solver debriefs should not alter escrow, bounty, or payment routing terms.
findings.remediation: Remove payment negotiation language and keep payout questions in the approved bounty platform.
